metadata.source: Reserve Bank of India Historical Archive & Ministry of Finance
metadata.exam_weightage: Extremely High (5-8 Questions across Mains shifts)

committees.name: Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance (Hilton Young Commission)
committees.mandate: Examining the Indian currency and exchange system and central banking framework
committees.landmark_recommendation: Recommended the creation of a central bank to be called the 'Reserve Bank of India' to separate the control of currency and credit from the Government.
committees.outcome: Enactment of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and establishment of RBI on April 1, 1935.

committees.name: All India Rural Credit Survey Committee (Gorwala Committee)
committees.mandate: Assessment of institutional rural credit supply in post-independence India
committees.landmark_recommendation: Recommended creation of a strong state-partnered commercial banking institution through amalgamation of Imperial Bank of India and major state-associated banks.
committees.outcome: Enactment of State Bank of India Act, 1955 and nationalisation/creation of State Bank of India on July 1, 1955.

committees.name: Committee on the Financial System (Narasimham Committee I)
committees.mandate: Blueprint for modern banking sector reforms post-1991 economic balance of payments crisis
committees.landmark_recommendation: Progressive reduction of high SLR and CRR, deregulation of bank lending/deposit interest rates, introduction of 4-tier banking structure, adoption of prudential norms for income recognition, asset classification, and provisioning.
committees.outcome: Entry of new private sector banks (HDFC, ICICI, Axis), introduction of 90-day NPA norms, and phased reduction of SLR from 38.5% towards 25%.

committees.name: Committee on Banking Sector Reforms (Narasimham Committee II)
committees.mandate: Strengthening banking system architecture, legal frameworks, and capital buffers
committees.landmark_recommendation: Creation of Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs), strengthening legal powers of lenders without court intervention, revision of capital adequacy norms, concept of 'Narrow Banking' for weak banks.
committees.outcome: Enactment of the SARFAESI Act, 2002; setting up of CERSAI; and foundation of modern NPA recovery machinery.

committees.name: Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development (CRAFICARD / Sivaraman Committee)
committees.mandate: Evaluating institutional credit delivery mechanism for rural agriculture
committees.landmark_recommendation: Creation of an apex national development bank dedicated exclusively to rural financing, agriculture, and cottage industries by transferring relevant departments from RBI.
committees.outcome: Passage of NABARD Act, 1981 and establishment of NABARD on July 12, 1982.

committees.name: Committee on Reforms in the Insurance Sector (Malhotra Committee)
committees.mandate: Reforms, demonopolisation, and restructuring of the Indian insurance sector
committees.landmark_recommendation: Opening up the domestic insurance market to private sector companies, permitting joint ventures with foreign players, and establishing an independent statutory regulatory body.
committees.outcome: Passage of the IRDA Act, 1999 and establishment of IRDAI in 2000.

committees.name: High-Level Committee on Agricultural Credit through Commercial Banks (R.V. Gupta Committee)
committees.mandate: Simplification of agricultural loan sanctioning procedures and credit delivery
committees.landmark_recommendation: Formulation of an easy revolving credit mechanism for farmers to purchase agricultural inputs and withdraw cash flexibly.
committees.outcome: Launch of the revolutionary Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme in August 1998.

committees.name: Working Group on Harmonising the Role and Operations of DFIs and Banks (Khan Committee)
committees.mandate: Examining structural convergence between specialized development financial institutions and commercial banks
committees.landmark_recommendation: Transition of specialized DFIs into full-fledged commercial banks under the concept of 'Universal Banking'.
committees.outcome: Reverse merger of ICICI with ICICI Bank (2002) and IDBI with IDBI Bank (2004).

committees.name: Committee on Comprehensive Financial Services for Small Businesses and Low-Income Households (Nachiket Mor Committee)
committees.mandate: Universal financial inclusion, deepen digital penetration, and institutional innovations
committees.landmark_recommendation: Pioneered the concept of 'Differentiated Banking Licences' in India: specifically proposing Payments Banks (for payments/remittances) and Small Finance Banks (for unserved credit).
committees.outcome: RBI issued guidelines for Payments Banks and Small Finance Banks in November 2014; launch of Airtel Payments Bank, Paytm, Equitas SFB, Ujjivan SFB, etc.

committees.name: Expert Committee to Revise and Strengthen the Monetary Policy Framework (Urjit Patel Committee)
committees.chairman: Dr. Urjit Patel (then Deputy Governor, RBI)
committees.mandate: Overhaul the operating procedures of monetary policy and inflation control in India
committees.landmark_recommendation: Shift anchor from WPI to CPI-Combined headline inflation; adopt flexible inflation targeting with target of 4% (+/- 2%); institutionalize monetary policy decisions through a statutory 6-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC).
committees.outcome: Amendment of RBI Act 1934 in 2016; creation of the statutory MPC; and operationalisation of modern inflation-targeting framework.

committees.name: Committee to Review Governance of Boards of Banks in India (P.J. Nayak Committee)
committees.chairman: P.J. Nayak (former Chairman of Axis Bank)
committees.mandate: Improving governance, autonomy, leadership selection, and performance of Public Sector Banks
committees.landmark_recommendation: Abolish dual regulation of PSBs, split CMD post into Chairman and MD/CEO, create an autonomous body for top banking appointments, and reduce government equity stake to below 50%.
committees.outcome: Creation of the Banks Board Bureau (BBB) in 2016, later restructured into Financial Services Institutions Bureau (FSIB) in 2022; separation of Chairman and MD/CEO roles in PSBs.

committees.name: Expert Committee on Economic Capital Framework (Bimal Jalan Committee)
committees.mandate: Determining appropriate levels of reserves, contingency risk buffer, and surplus transfer from RBI to Government of India
committees.landmark_recommendation: Maintain Contingency Risk Buffer (CRB) within a band of 5.5% to 6.5% of RBI's balance sheet; transfer excess realized equity beyond this buffer to the Government as dividend.
committees.outcome: Historic surplus capital dividend transfer of ₹1.76 Lakh Crore from RBI to Government of India in August 2019.

exam_traps.trap: Confusing Nachiket Mor Committee with Urjit Patel Committee.
exam_traps.fact: Nachiket Mor Committee recommended Differentiated Banking Licences (Payments Banks and SFBs). Urjit Patel Committee recommended Inflation Targeting (4% +/- 2%) and the MPC.
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) was recommended by the R.V. Gupta Committee (1998).

exam_traps.trap: Thinking Gorwala Committee recommended creation of RBI.
exam_traps.fact: Hilton Young Commission recommended RBI (1926). Gorwala Committee recommended creation of State Bank of India (1954).
